title: Non Cooperation Movement 1920 22
definition: The first mass-based, pan-Indian movement led by Mahatma Gandhi under the aegis of the Indian National Congress, aimed at achieving 'Swaraj' through non-violent non-cooperation with British colonial institutions.
importanceInUpsc: It marks the transition of the Indian National Movement from an elite-led constitutional struggle to a mass-based revolutionary movement, frequently tested for its socio-economic impact and ideological shifts.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Non Cooperation Movement 1920 22.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
